_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ni wowe Umukinnyi {player_id} muri kinyago cha LinesOfAction.
Ibikorwa byawe ni '{side}', ibikorwa by'uwanyago ni '{other}'.
Fomu ya kwimuka: `[b1b3]` (koordineti ya kurekebishwa hadi koordineti ya kujerera). Kwimuka kwemera kwimuka kwa mpande, kwimuka juu-chini, cyangwa kwimuka diagonally idadi ya miraba inalingana na jumla ya bikorwa (iraba ryose) muri kile kilalo. Urashobora kuruka ibikorwa byawe, ariko si ibikorwa by'uwanyago; kugera kwa uwanyago bikurikira.  Ushatse unapowusha ibikorwa byawe byose bikora 8-mbere-hanyuma.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Imiterere igomba kuba e2e4 (kuva, kugeza kuri coordinates).
invalid_move.identical: Aho ituruka n'aho ijya ni bimwe.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Kugenda bigomba kuba byoroshye cyangwa bigahita.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Igomba kugenda intera ingana n'ibice biri mu murongo.
invalid_move.destination_own: Aho bagiye ni ahantu umuntu aba ari wenyine.

game_action.captured_suffix: Umukino {player_id} yashinze {from} -> {to} yakuriye umukino wa kimwe.
